source.name: Al Shamal SC (Instagram): 2026/27 kit launch post
source.quote: This is the Al Shamal jersey for the 2026/27 season.
source.note: Kit maker, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. The post's caption is bilingual (Arabic and English) and its carousel shows the red home shirt and white away shirt carrying only the adidas mark and the club crest on the chest, adidas three-stripes on the shoulders and shorts, with no commercial sponsor on the front, sleeves or shorts; the photos show no back view.

summary: adidas home kit (red) with no commercial shirt sponsors: the club's kit-launch post shows the front, sleeves and shorts of the shirt carrying only the adidas mark, the club crest and adidas three-stripes, with no other logos. The post's photos show no back view, so the sponsor list is not marked complete.
